goal.raw_text: The VMU User reviews the provider's claim to verify its validity and data completeness, determining whether the claim status should be 'Accepted', 'Rejection', or 'Quarantine' based on the presence of false or missing mandatory information, and investigates conspicuous claims for clearance.

claims.content: VMU User
The provider's claim has been submitted with all mandatory information completed, as the system only accepts claims when mandatory information is complete.
The claim data from the manual form has been entered into the computer database for processing and review.
The system has evaluated the claim for false data or missing mandatory information and assigned an initial status (Accepted, Rejection, or Quarantine) based on this evaluation.
If the claim is identified as conspicuous, it has been flagged for investigation and clearance by the VMU.
The VMU User reviews a provider claim status when the MSIU field office receives the monthly collected claim forms from the VSP.

trigger.raw_text: The VMU User reviews a provider claim status when the MSIU field office receives the monthly collected claim forms from the VSP.

claims.content: The VMU User accesses the claim record in the system to review its current status and associated data.
The system displays the claim status, which is determined based on whether any false data or mandatory information is missing; if no issues are found, the status is 'Accepted'.

If the claim status is not 'Accepted' (i.e., it is 'Rejection' or 'Quarantine'), the system allows the VMU User to view or capture the reason for this status from the Claim Quarantine / Rejection Reason Master.
For claims flagged as conspicuous, the VMU User initiates an investigation to clear the claim, as part of the monitoring system operated by the VMU.
The VMU User may alter or amend the claim details if required during the review process.

If the claim status is not 'Accepted' (i.e., 'Rejection' or 'Quarantine'), the system stores the claim in the quarantine area and allows further processing based on its status, while capturing the reason from the Claim Quarantine / Rejection Reason Master.
For conspicuous claims flagged during review, the VMU initiates an investigation to clear the claim as part of the monitoring system.

If the thumb impression on a claim form mismatches previous visits for the same patient and voucher, the system automatically counts the mismatch; if more than two mismatches occur from the same VSP, the system produces a warning message and in-activates the VSP.
If any mandatory information is missed or false information exists in the claim, the field office rejects the claim back to the VSP and the system keeps the claim in a quarantine area.

If the claim status is not 'Accepted' (i.e., 'Rejection' or 'Quarantine'), the claim is stored in the quarantine area and the system captures the reason from the Claim Quarantine / Rejection Reason Master.

If the thumb impression mismatches for the same patient on the same voucher, the system automatically counts the mismatch; if more than two mismatches occur from the same VSP, the system produces a warning message and inactivates the VSP.
The claim status is updated to 'Accepted', 'Rejection', or 'Quarantine' based on whether false data or missing mandatory information exists in the claim.
If the claim status is not 'Accepted', the claim is stored in the quarantine area and the system captures the reason from the Claim Quarantine / Rejection Reason Master.
Conspicuous claims flagged during review are investigated and cleared by the VMU as part of the monitoring system.
If thumb impression mismatches occur more than twice for the same VSP, the system produces a warning message and inactivates the VSP.
Rejected claims are sent back to the VSP for verification; if returned with satisfactory details, they are re-entered in the following month’s batch.
